gate_def: sigmoid of the real outputs of gate_low (64 ch), gate_mid (128 ch) and gate_high (256 ch), concatenated (448 channels) and averaged over those 448 channels per point; hooks on the actual gate Conv1d modules
curl_def: |dv/dx - du/dy| per point, estimated by the k=24 nearest-neighbour local linear fit from the reference (ground-truth) u and v fields, not from model predictions
gradT_def: ||grad T|| per point from the reference (ground-truth) T field, k=24 nearest-neighbour local linear fit
wall_dist_def: Euclidean distance to the nearest sampled boundary point (the first 660 points of each geometry; cKDTree k=1). Boundary points themselves are 0 because they are their own nearest sampled point; the second-nearest point is not used. This is distance to sampled boundary points, not an exact continuous wall distance

norm.source: per-seed metrics protocol (train-only z-score, fit on the 100 Protocol-A train geoms)

statistics_note: Descriptive association only; no causal interpretation and the sign of any correlation is not presupposed. Statistical unit: seed mean over the 20 test geometries; cross-seed mean/sample-std over 5 seeds.
